Iran live updates: US military repositions personnel at Mideast bases, source says (ABC News, October 21, 2026)

7:49 PM EDT (00:49 BST 22 Oct) — US military repositioning personnel at bases in the Middle East
The U.S. military has repositioned personnel at Middle Eastern bases, mirroring quiet movements before the February war start, according to a source familiar with the matter.
CENTCOM spokesman Capt. Tim Hawkins stated: "We regularly move U.S. service members and assets to optimize mission readiness. We do not discuss related movements for operational security reasons."
The State Department ordered non-essential personnel and family members to depart Saudi Arabia due to Houthi threats.

6:33 PM EDT (23:33 BST) — 1 dead, 8 injured in strike on Saudi airport
A King Fahd International Airport attack in Dammam resulted in one fatality and eight injuries ranging from minor to severe, according to Saudi civil aviation authorities. Material damage is being assessed.

8:17 AM EDT — IRGC commander threatens internet cables in Strait of Hormuz
Brig. Gen. Yadollah Javani warned Iran could target seven undersea internet cables if the U.S. resumes attacks, stating the Islamic Republic would "leverage its full capabilities to readily destroy their assets."

8:06 AM EDT — Tankers attacked off Iraqi, Omani coasts
Two separate tanker incidents: one struck near Al Faw, Iraq (crew safe); another hit off Oman's coast causing a fire, now extinguished.
